# Figure provenance

`measurement_problem`, `thickness_retrieval`, `structured_retrieval`,
`rdw_retrieval`, `trace_validation` and `smearing_examples` are figures from
the two companion papers by J. C. Travers and C. Brahms (in preparation; see
`docs/reference/bibliography.md`), produced from the papers' own figure scripts
and data. `figure_boxcars3d` is the instrument geometry schematic. All are
static images; the documentation build does not regenerate them. Their captions
are in `docs/explanation/validation.md`.

The remaining `figure_*` files are kept so that existing links to them keep
working; the manual no longer uses them.
